d: Agar hausle buland hon to mushkil se mushkil halat bhi insan ka rasta nahin rok sakte. bhagalpur ke jichho ilake ki rahne vali lalita devi ne apni mehnat aur aatmavishvas se is kahavat ko sach kar dikhaya hai. kabhi dusron ke gharon men kam karne vali lalita ab dusri mahilaon ko apne pairon par khara hone ka rasta dikha rahi hain.
